patterns.note: Content sections frequently use a two-column layout, often with a main content block on the left and a smaller, related information or call-to-action block on the right.

A high-contrast color scheme of black and white is consistently used for backgrounds and text, with NVIDIA's signature bright green serving as the primary accent color for calls-to-action, links, and key highlights.

As the user scrolls, the initial transparent, larger top navigation bar shrinks in height and gains a solid dark background, becoming sticky. Simultaneously, a secondary navigation bar (Overview, Demo, etc.) also becomes sticky below the main nav, and the hero content (text and globe graphic) exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving at a different rate than the scroll.
Headings are large, bold, and use a sans-serif font, creating a strong visual hierarchy. Many sub-labels and navigation items are presented in uppercase for emphasis.
Key information is presented in distinct, full-width sections that alternate between white and black backgrounds, providing clear visual separation and guiding the user through the content.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image (or video, as hinted) with a dark overlay to ensure text legibility, and the content within it is initially centered before shifting to left-alignment on scroll.

The navigation system employs a dynamic sticky header: the primary navigation bar reduces in height and changes its background from transparent to solid dark upon scrolling, while a secondary page-specific navigation bar also becomes sticky and gains a solid background, both using CSS keyframes for smooth transitions.

Scroll-triggered parallax is applied to the hero graphic, where the background element moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth and subtle animation as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller uppercase labels for navigation and sub-sections.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — with an airy hero section and a more compact, information-dense footer.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated use of NVIDIA's brand green as a high-contrast accent against a predominantly black and white canvas, creating a powerful, authoritative, and modern tech aesthetic. The dynamic sticky navigation and subtle hero parallax contribute to a premium user experience, reinforcing the brand's high-tech identity.
